scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn opsledger.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @opsledger/web && cd apps/api && uv run ruff check .
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @opsledger/web && cd apps/api && uv run pytest
scripts.migrate: cd apps/api && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.seed: cd apps/api && uv run python -m opsledger.seed
